brief:
Israel has confirmed the death of Palestinian detainee Ihab Diab, nearly two years after he died in prison, Al Jazeera English reported. The family disputes Israeli claims that health complications caused his death, instead alleging that torture was responsible for his death in custody.

The confirmation came after a prolonged period during which Israeli authorities had not publicly acknowledged Diab's death. Families of Palestinians held by Israel have repeatedly accused the military and security services of mistreatment and torture during detention. The Diab family's allegations add to a broader pattern of disputed circumstances surrounding detainee deaths in Israeli custody, with Palestinian relatives frequently challenging official explanations provided by authorities.
dek: The family of Ihab Diab disputes Israeli claims of health issues, alleging torture was behind his prison death.
title: Israel confirms death of Palestinian detainee nearly two years after death
